basis: The City of Zagreb Assembly explanatory note (page 1) calls the museum an institution in culture whose founder's rights the City of Zagreb exercises, and the draft statute amendment says the museum's governing board adopts statute changes with the Assembly's prior consent.

Article 6 of Law 41-00 (PDF pages 5 and 6) lists the Museo de Arte Moderno among the institutions placed directly under the culture ministry's administrative, technical and budgetary jurisdiction, and Decree 251-22 (page 1) treats that law as still the basis of today's Ministry of Culture.
